references.text: Jesus' promise that the Father will send another Helper (the Holy Spirit) who will teach the disciples everything corresponds directly to verse 16, where Jesus asks the Father to give another Helper.
Here the promise is confirmed that the Father will send the Helper in Jesus' name, which expands on the function of the 'another Helper' mentioned in 14:16.
Jesus explains that it is for their benefit that He goes away, so that He can send the Helper, which is the direct prerequisite for the promise in 14:16.

The description of the Helper as the 'spirit of truth,' whom the world cannot receive but whom the disciples know because He 'dwells with them,' expands on the promise that He will be 'with them' in 14:16.
Jesus' assurance that He will not leave the disciples as orphans, but will come to them, is the concrete fulfillment of the promise that the Helper will be with them 'forever.'
The promise that the Father and the Son will come and dwell with the one who loves Jesus mirrors the promise in 14:16 that the Helper will be with the disciples forever.
